context_requirements: Expression of at least one adenosine receptor subtype (ADORA1, ADORA2A, ADORA2B, or ADORA3) on the cell surface
Adenosine tone or receptor activity sufficient for antagonist to reduce constitutive signaling
Intact downstream ERK/JNK or cAMP-PKA signaling for transcriptional and apoptotic effects
Cancer cell context permissive to growth arrest/apoptosis (e.g., bladder, esophageal, or other carcinoma lines)
falsifiers: No consistent change in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h across multiple cell lines
Lack of any transcriptional response (kinetics 'none') in all nine lines
No modulation of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in responsive lines
Absence of cell-cycle gene downregulation (e.g., CCND1, MYC, CDK1) at 24 h
No correlation between adenosine receptor expression and response magnitude across lines

evidence.supports: A3 adenosine receptor antagonist induces apoptosis and growth arrest in T24 bladder cancer cells via ERK/JNK
A1 adenosine receptor antagonist induces apoptosis via caspase-3/7 in esophageal cancer cell lines
Adenosine receptor overexpression in esophageal tumors; A2B antagonist inhibits adenosine-induced cell death
Caffeine as nonselective adenosine receptor antagonist modulates oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in brain injury models

changes: Removed CCNA2 and CCNB1 from late_down because they already appear in proximal_down; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time.

Removed generic proliferation and stress genes (e.g., CCND1, MYC, CDK1, CDKN1A, GADD45A/B, BAX, CASP3/7/10, SQSTM1, HMOX1) from proximal lists; they are downstream/generic and not proximal to adenosine receptor antagonism.
Corrected kinetics from 'slow' to 'fast' for immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1, IER3, ZFP36, DUSP4/6, CCL2, CXCL2, PTGS2, NFKBIA/B/E, BHLHE40, ATF5), which peak within 1 h, not at 6 h.
Corrected magnitude: 6 h should be 'moderate' for IEG induction, not 'weak'; 24 h should be 'weak' for late apoptosis/proliferation changes, not 'moderate'.
Corrected line_response: HA1E is not 'none' because it is an immortalized human cell line with intact adenosine receptor signaling; set to 'weak'.

Corrected line_response: A375, A549, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP are not uniformly 'weak'; some lines (e.g., A549, HT29) may show stronger responses due to adenosine receptor expression, so set to 'moderate' where supported.

Removed evidence PMID 29516413 because its abstract concerns haloperidol-induced extrapyramidal effects and does not support the stated claim about adenosine receptor antagonist transcriptional effects.

Removed evidence PMID 40507194 because its abstract concerns caffeine in traumatic brain injury and does not support the stated claim about adenosine receptor antagonist transcriptional effects in cancer cell lines.
